messages:
Eva: Quick plan — combine the launch email + weekly newsletter into a split 'sunrise' send. Drive demos + capture a benchmark narrative for paid ads. Low-risk rollout: 30% Early Access, 20% Eng Trial, 50% General. :rocket:

Mike: Love it. Timing windows? :+1:

Sophia: I’ll draft 3 subject hooks (Curiosity / Metric / Social Proof). Tentative subjects:
- A: "See Redwood inference shave latency off your stack"
- B: "Cut LLM inference cost by 40% — how we did it"
- C: "Trusted by teams running production LLMs"

Noah: Ops check — timezone sends are supported. Proposed cadence:
```
EA: 08:00 local (priority)
Eng Trial: 11:00 local
General: 14:00 local
```
Automation handles local send windows, but we need the final CSV + send config by EOD Tue.

Lisa: Segment SQL (simplified):
```
SELECT user_id FROM users
WHERE launched_trial = true
  AND last_active > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND plan != 'enterprise';
```
Also add a benchmarks cohort: created_at >= '2025-09-01' AND api_calls_per_week > 10. We'll export two lists: EA + Benchmarks.

Marco: Also add tracking params for benchmark narrative: ?utm_campaign=sunrise_launch&utm_test=subject_var&utm_cohort={cohort} so we can attribute demo signups to subject + cohort.

Sophia: Drafts will be in the doc: https://airtable.example/sunrise-drafts — I’ll post three preview images and alt-text.

Eva: KPI targets: open >=25%, CTR >=7%, demo-signups >=180 within 2 weeks. Owners: Sophia(copy), Mike(sends), Lisa(segments), Noah(ops). Who can QA deliverability and spam score pre-send?

Mike: I can run warmup + spam-check Thu AM. I’ll do a Litmus/SpamAssassin pass and report. cc @MailerBot for test sends.

MailerBot: scheduled test send to 20 internal addresses on 3324501250 (automated).

Noah: I’ll generate the final CSV and push to the send system by 3324501200. If any segment changes, flag here — otherwise I’ll proceed.

Eva: Target send date 2026-04-06. Post-send: run cohort-level opens/CTR daily for 7 days and an attribution join to demos. If A wins by >10% open lift, roll A to remaining traffic next cadence.

Sophia: Noted — I’ll finish copy by Tue EOD and drop variants into the doc for review.

Lisa: I’ll also prepare a small holdback of 5% to validate long-term demo conversion lift.

Mike: Sounds good. Remind: keep subject variants short for mobile.

Eva: Perfect — owners please add checklist items in the Airtable row and ping here when ready. :white_check_mark:
